subject: Interest after Launch Week webinar — Demo & compliance questions
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novatech.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick demo request — saw Redwood at Launch Week

Hi Irene,

I attended the Launch Week session on inference economics and signed up for follow-up. Novatech is evaluating inference platforms for a latency-sensitive fraud-detection feature — we need sub-50ms tail latency on short prompts and strong auditability.

Would love a 30–45 minute walkthrough of Redwood’s routing and observability features plus a quick chat on compliance (SOC 2 evidence, data residency).

Our availability next week is fairly flexible: Tues/Wed mornings PST or Thurs afternoon. I can loop in our security lead if useful (cc'd Marissa).

Thanks —
Alex Johnson
Senior Engineering Manager, Novatech
alex.johnson@novatech.com
+1 415-555-0182
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novatech.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — saw Redwood at Launch Week

Hi Alex — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for joining Launch Week. I’m on the SDR/AE handoff for Launch Week leads — happy to get a short demo on the calendar.

What I can do now:
- Quick 30-minute demo with Ben (solutions AE) to cover routing, latency controls, and observability.
- Share our SOC 2 summary and a pre-demo checklist so the convo hits the right technical points.

Two ways to pick time: use this quick scheduler (30 min slots) or reply with preferred times.
https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-demo?deal=DEAL-7891

If you want security details front-and-center, I can invite our security engineer or we can do a separate compliance sync.

Attached: demo-intake-form.pdf — a very short form (1 page) that helps us tailor the demo — if you can share approximate request volume and whether you prefer hosted/dedicated/private that helps.

Would just confirm the timezone you’re in — PST?

Best,
Irene Choi
Sales Development Rep, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novatech.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Gill <marissa.gill@novatech.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2026 08:36:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — saw Redwood at Launch Week

Thanks Irene — yes PST (we're SF-based). I've filled out the intake form and included a couple notes:
- Target: ~2000 requests/minute at 32 tokens average for scoring model; 95th token latency target <= 50ms.
- Data residency: US-only preferred; SOC 2 required for procurement.

We can do Wed Nov 3 10:00–10:30 PST or Thu Nov 4 after 15:00 PST — either works. If possible, please include any SOC 2 summary or evidence links ahead of time so Marissa (security) can scan.

Appreciate it —
Alex
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novatech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — saw Redwood at Launch Week

Perfect — thanks for the details, Alex. I booked Thu Nov 4 at 15:30 PST for a 30-minute intro and added Ben so he can walk through routing/autoscaling and SLA conversation. Calendar invite attached (calendar-invite-Redwood-Nov4.ics).

Agenda (30 min):
- 5m intro & goals
- 12m demo: routing, latency SLOs, observability (tracing + cost per token)
- 8m security/compliance Q&A (Ben will cover SOC 2 summary and where we store logs)
- 5m next steps (POC, Dedicated sizing)

Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf (product snapshot) and SOC_2_summary_link in the notes. If Marissa wants deeper artifacts ahead of time I can open a secure share — let me know.

Link to join will be in the calendar invite; if you prefer a different conferencing tool let me know and we’ll switch.

Looking forward —
Irene
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@novatech.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Gill <marissa.gill@novatech.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — saw Redwood at Launch Week

Thanks — confirmed on our side for Thu 15:30 PST (I see the calendar invite). Ben — great to have you. Marissa will join for the compliance section.

One quick ask: can you include a short slide or note on model routing across regions (we may need to route inference across US-East/US-West for redundancy)? If that’s heavy we can cover it in follow-up.

See you Thursday.

— Alex
